# Allowed permissions for EVLauncher.
# Any uses-permission in a manifest NOT listed here FAILS the CI.
# Why: this app replaces the home screen. It runs on every boot, sees every installed
# package, and is the first thing the driver touches. Every new permission widens that
# surface and must be reviewed here.
#
# One line = one full permission name. '#' = comment.

# --- App drawer ---
# Required on API 30+ to enumerate launchable apps. Without it the drawer is empty.
android.permission.QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES

# --- Metrics page (carousel page 2) ---
# Read-only: active connection type and Wi-Fi link speed. Neither permission opens a
# socket, and neither exposes SSID/BSSID/MAC (never queried).
android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
android.permission.ACCESS_WIFI_STATE

# --- Metrics page, data-usage cards ---
# Read-only, device-wide byte counters — the same numbers Android's own Settings screen
# shows. No per-app breakdown is queried, so no inference about which apps the driver uses.
# The since-boot card needs nothing (TrafficStats); the two windowed cards fall back to
# "unreadable" rather than to zero when this is not granted, so refusing it degrades two
# cards and nothing else. Reviewed in docs/CR-011-metrics-page.md.
android.permission.PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS

# --- Metrics page, weather card ---
# The head unit's weather service answers for a position, so the weather card needs one.
# This is the launcher's only runtime permission, and it is confined to that card:
#   * requested at runtime the FIRST TIME A WEATHER CARD IS DISPLAYED, never at launch —
#     a driver who does not add the card is never asked;
#   * the position subscription is held only while the metrics page is visible and only
#     while a weather card is on it, and is dropped in onPause — no background location;
#   * the fix is used for one thing, a weather query, and is never stored or transmitted;
#   * without the grant the card reads "—" and says why. Nothing else on the page changes.
# Both grades are listed because since API 31 the user may grant the approximate one when
# the precise one was asked for, and a city's weather does not need the precise one.
# Reviewed in docs/CR-011-metrics-page.md.
android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION

# --- User-initiated EVSuite release checks ---
# Used only when the EVSuite screen checks GitHub or downloads a user-confirmed APK.
# There is no background check, self-update, silent installer, or remote-control path.
android.permission.INTERNET

# --- Vehicle cards on the metrics page ---
# READ ONLY. Neither permission permits a vehicle write, and the app calls no setter: every
# value goes through EVHardware's telemetry reader, which exposes getters only.
# CAR_ENERGY       — standard AAOS range remaining and charge-port-connected reads.
# CAR_VENDOR_EXTENSION — the vendor property space cannot be read at all without it; it
#                    carries the SWI68 fallbacks for state of charge and range.
# Justification and the reasoning for what was NOT added: docs/CR-010-vehicle-page.md.
android.car.permission.CAR_ENERGY
android.car.permission.CAR_VENDOR_EXTENSION

# --- Dealer/Service mode ---
# Signature-level. Used only by the EVSuite screen's Service-mode button to disable or
# re-enable the other EVSuite packages from a fixed catalogue; the launcher never targets
# itself. Not a vehicle write. On a build without the suite signature the call is refused and
# reported. Not a privileged UID: no sharedUserId.
android.permission.CHANGE_COMPONENT_ENABLED_STATE

# --- Deliberately NOT allowed ---
# CAR_SPEED, CAR_EXTERIOR_ENVIRONMENT, CONTROL_CAR_CLIMATE, CAR_MILEAGE, CAR_ENERGY_PORTS,
# CAR_TIRES — held by EVChargePilot or by nobody in the suite, and not here. The metrics
# picker offers those cards anyway; without the permission each reads "—" with "unavailable
# on this car", which is what the page already says about any signal the car does not answer.
# The app that owns the home screen holds no permission whose name contains CONTROL.
# ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION — the weather card reads a position only while the driver is
# looking at the page. There is no background location path and there must not be one.
# Any android.car.permission.* granting a write, and sharedUserId: never.
# Installation always remains user-mediated by Android's package installer.
